sources.articleTitle: Woman objects to molestation, gets pushed off Mumbai local train, loses left arm
Woman loses arm after being pushed off platform at Naigaon railway station; suspect arrested

headline: Man Arrested After Woman Pushed From Mumbai Railway Platform
seoTitle: Man Arrested After Woman Pushed From Train
metaDescription: Police have arrested a suspect after a woman was pushed from a railway platform in Mumbai, resulting in the loss of her left arm following an incident.
aiSummaryBullets: A 20-year-old woman lost her left arm after being pushed off a railway platform at Naigaon station.
The incident occurred on November 4 following an alleged instance of molestation.
Police used CCTV footage to identify and apprehend a 53-year-old male suspect.
aiContextParagraph: On November 4, 2026, a 20-year-old woman was pushed from a platform at the Naigaon railway station in Mumbai, India. The incident reportedly occurred after the victim objected to being molested by a 53-year-old man. As a result of the fall, the woman suffered severe injuries leading to the loss of her left arm and is currently receiving medical treatment. Local law enforcement authorities initiated an investigation into the matter, utilizing security footage from the railway station to identify the perpetrator. Following the review of the CCTV recordings, officers arrested the man. Legal action has been taken against the accused under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, with charges including molestation and attempted murder. The investigation remains ongoing as authorities process the case following the arrest of the suspect identified in the surveillance materials.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained moderate traction across two major Indian news outlets with a steady coverage velocity, indicating significant public interest in the incident.
